acceptance_criteria: Retention rule per kit-keyed table recorded; PRIVACY.md, DATA-MODEL and p9-retention agree
description:
DATA-MODEL section 6 and PRIVACY.md give a retention rule only for raw events (replaced by per-step aggregates without kit ids 12 months after the class ends). kit_progress, facilitator_notes, quiz_responses, exit_cards and device_sessions also carry kit_id, but no retention rule covers them, so they would be kept indefinitely unless a kit is deleted. step_aggregates is also not defined in the DATA-MODEL schema.

Needed: a retention rule for each kit-keyed table (or an explicit decision to keep it), checked against the research approval (p0-consent).

Filed during beads setup (prompt 01, step 8).
title: DECISION: retention for kit-keyed data other than raw events
